newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China's Jiang, Li due in HK Monday for handover.
newsitem.headline: China's Jiang, Li due in HK Monday for handover.

text.p: Chinese President Jiang Zemin and Premier Li Peng will arrive in Hong Kong on Monday afternoon just a few hours ahead of the British colony's historic return to Beijing rule, the Hong Kong government said on Sunday.
The government gave no exact time for the arrival but it said the two leaders would come by air.
Jiang will lead the Chinese delegation taking back Hong Kong from the hands of Britain's Prince Charles on the stroke of midnight (1600 GMT) on Monday.
